atoms.text: Mateo and Fabio are riding their bikes to school. On the way, Fabio rides into a pothole, his front wheel twists suddenly, and he falls onto the ground.
When Mateo rushes to help him, it quickly becomes clear that Fabio cannot walk. His knee is in a lot of pain. Mateo helps Fabio get to the pavement and sit down. Mateo wants to call for help.

feedback.end: In the event of an accident, you should always call 999. By phoning 999, you can reach the emergency services and get medical help. Depending on the situation, the call operator might also inform the fire service or police.

atoms.text: When the ambulance arrives, Fabio is told his knee is only bruised and, after half an hour with an ice pack, it should be fine.

atoms.text: Before the paramedics go, they tell the boys that it was right to call, even if the injury turned out not to be serious.

atoms.a: When should you call an ambulance?
b: You should only call an ambulance when someone has severe or life-threatening injuries.
++You should call an ambulance even if you are unsure how serious the persons injuries are.

instruction.text: Think about the conversation between Mateo and the ambulance telephone operator. Drag all questions that the operator asked onto the notepad.

finish.text:
On every 999 call, certain questions are asked. These were the questions Mateo answered:

Which service do you require?
What happened?
Is the person injured?
When did it happen?
Where did it happen?
Where are you now?
